items.title: Typical ZnSSeTe MSC route
items.text: Airless injection of ZnEt2 and mixed (Me2N)3P=X chalcogen stocks into OLA/ODE; heat to 300 °C; wash by ethanol/centrifugation and redisperse in n-hexane.

items.text: S is prepared from 0.064 g/2 mmol elemental S and 2 mL/11 mmol HMPT; the paper calls this 1 M. The source discusses possible transamination in OLA, so formula cards do not assert solution species.
